scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name avorlune --branch main
scripts.db:stamp:local: wrangler d1 execute avorlune-production --local --command "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO app_meta (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('environment','development',datetime('now'))"
scripts.db:stamp:prod: wrangler d1 execute avorlune-production --remote --command "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO app_meta (key, value, updated_at) VALUES ('environment','production',datetime('now'))"
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name avorlune --branch preview
